# Aperta

> Aperta is a Hebrew-language platform for designing open brass bracelets and
> rings from a plain-language description. You describe a cutout pattern in
> words; an AI generates it and automatically checks it is manufacturable
> (bridge widths, hole sizes, margins, roll-forming survivability). Once you
> approve it, we laser-cut, roll-form and finish the piece by hand and ship
> it to you. Precision jewelry, formed around you.

## Product
- Material: C260 brass, 1.5 mm, fiber-laser cut, roll-formed into an open arc.
- Products: open bracelet (from ₪399), open ring (from ₪299), VAT included.
- Made to order, 10–14 working days.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://aperta-designs.com/): what Aperta is and how to start.
- [Design](https://aperta-designs.com/design): the guided client journey — product, sizes, idea & upload, AI chat, design suggestions, edit, and final visualization & price.
- [How it works](https://aperta-designs.com/how-it-works): the four steps — describe, generate, production check, and we make and ship it.
- [Gallery](https://aperta-designs.com/gallery): illustrative pattern styles.
- [Sizing guide](https://aperta-designs.com/sizing): how to measure a ring size and a wrist at home, US ring size conversion table, and what each cuff fit style adds.
- [Design rules](https://aperta-designs.com/design-rules): what the image model will refuse to draw, why, and what to write instead.
- [Care](https://aperta-designs.com/care): how brass behaves over time, the cleaning routine, and what to avoid.
- [FAQ](https://aperta-designs.com/faq): material, sizes, ordering, base prices and lead time.
- [Contact](https://aperta-designs.com/contact): reach the team.

## Notes
- Pricing is shown on the order page and follows the product, size and design; lead time is 10-14 working days.
- Gallery images are decorative illustrations, not products for sale.
